answer: A sybil attacker can mint many cheap identities, but value on this chain is not per identity, it is per verified service: each honest agent accrues standing like a pearl grows in layers, and a clone cannot fake those layers no matter the tide of copies it releases. Real reputation is earned only through sustained attested work, so a forgery wave passes like a zephyr, brief and shallow, while the solid identities remain. Cost scales with depth, not count, which prices mass forgery out.
